_doc: Untethered test areas for the TDP 2027 motion experiments, in vision/field coordinates (m, deg). Used by `config.py area NAME`: the kenobi play's target area and abort box, and TDP_AREA for the ROS test scripts' safety monitor. heading_deg is the default robot heading for home poses. Vision always reports the full field, including when testing on the patch.

field.note: lab field, measured to the lines (4470 x 2615 mm)
